title: #comefromaway
transcript: so y'all I did it — I watched “come from away” on apple tv+ — so listen: it's not a big secret that I wasn't the hugest fan of the show I joke that it felt like a singing “welcome to Canada” brochure but this exquisite pro shot I think has shifted my thoughts on the show perhaps it’s the fact that the themes of community present in the show were amplified but the fact that they capture the show during a pandemic perhaps I simply miss live theater and perhaps I've softened over the past 18 months or all of the above most likely the fact that the show which features an ensemble cast of normal looking adults a basic unit set no real breakout song except for one maybe the fact that it's become this international hit I think it's pretty revolutionary this is a show that knows exactly what it is it trusts itself it doesn't inject some manufactured plot device to give more drama to it. now I don't think it is completely perfect it does seem to cater to a yt middle class audience particularly the way it deals with characters like Ali and the only character who gets the solo is a white lady but not every show is perfect there's a lot of good here — if you love the show you love this live capture
classificationReason: This is a review of the Apple TV+ filmed version, not a live stage production. Film/movie reviews are classified as 'other'
